PublicTeam.description: Public team leaderboard entry containing team name, emblem, and public points

PlatformConfig.title: PlatformConfig
PlatformConfig.description: Administrative platform configuration and custom question bank (Admin only)

PublicPlatformConfig.title: PublicPlatformConfig
PublicPlatformConfig.description: Publicly visible season metadata, awards showcase, and seasons archive

RealPortfolioProject.title: RealPortfolioProject
RealPortfolioProject.description: Authentic user project, competition, game, app, or invention

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Authorized platform administrator or supervisor document

PrivateQuestionAnswerKeyDoc.title: PrivateQuestionAnswerKeyDoc
PrivateQuestionAnswerKeyDoc.description: Protected Answer Key document (Admin/Server read, list, and write only)

OfficialExamAttempt.title: OfficialExamAttempt
OfficialExamAttempt.description: Server-generated official exam attempt containing ONLY the 30 selected questions for the student without answer keys

/students/{studentId}.description: Private student records — strictly readable by owner student (get only) or Admin (get/list)

/leaderboard_students/{studentId}.description: Public sanitized leaderboard entries for national rankings and governorate stats

/schools/{schoolId}.description: Administrative school records — Admin read/update/delete only

/public_schools/{schoolId}.description: Public school directory — public read, Admin update/delete

/teams/{teamId}.description: Administrative team records — Admin read/update/delete only

/public_teams/{teamId}.description: Public team leaderboard — public read, Admin update/delete

/platform/{docId}.description: Administrative platform settings and custom question bank — Admin read/write only

/public_platform/{docId}.description: Public season status, awards showcase, seasons archive, and sanitized public exam questions (without correctIndex/explanation) — public read, Admin write only

/question_answer_keys/{keyDocId}.description: Protected Answer Key store — Admin/Server read, list, and write only

/exam_attempts/{attemptId}.description: Server-generated official exam attempts — owner student get only; Admin/Server create, update, list, delete

/projects/{projectId}.description: Real user projects — public read for published projects, Admin read/write for all

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Trusted collection of supervisor UIDs for Firestore role verification
